lockFileMaintenance.description: Transitive dependencies in package-lock.json and the example lock files change only through lock file maintenance. The default schedule, before 4am on Monday, never matches the org runner's Monday 15:00 UTC run.

packageRules.description: The MCP SDK packages release together under one version. Update them in one PR so they never mix versions.
The workflows test on Node 22, the engines floor in package.json, and on later lines. Change them by hand together with engines.
